tagline: Open CSV files too big for Excel
brief: A free browser tool for Excel users holding CSV files too big for Excel, often confidential and on locked-down work laptops. It should feel calm, capable and trustworthy, and be memorable enough that people tell colleagues.
criteria: Distinct from grids, tables and arrows used by data tools; a character the brand can use everywhere; readable as a 16 px favicon.

concepts.name: The blue whale
concepts.idea: The largest animal on earth, in cobalt; its throat grooves are rows of data.
rationale: Big and calm: the thing that swallows files Excel can't
A character for loading screens, empty states, stickers and the 404 page
Simplified silhouette carries the favicon at 16 px

recommendation: The blue whale, with the simplified silhouette for favicons and the white-on-cobalt tile as the app icon.
next_steps: Animated version for loading and launch video
Apply to the site and app redesign
